summary: Implemented executor window-function support with a dedicated planner Window phase and efficient Python evaluation for partitioning, ordering, ranking, aggregate/navigation functions, frames (ROWS/RANGE/GROUPS), exclusions, IGNORE NULLS, QUALIFY, named windows, grouped windows, joins, and subqueries. Added window-aware optimizer handling to avoid unsafe subquery unnesting. Validated via targeted functional, join/subquery/grouped, frame/navigation, baseline, compilation, and 50k-row performance checks.
